Styles of dynamic spectrograms

Source: R/dynaspec.R
styles.Rd

Set the style of a dynaspec() object:

  • ds_scrolling(): the spectrogram scrolls from right to left along a fixed play line.

  • ds_paged(): the spectrogram is split into pages, and a translucent box reveals the part of each page being played.

  • ds_static(): a play line moves over the whole spectrogram (and oscillogram), which can be split in several rows (default style).

Usage

ds_scrolling(
  t.display,
  fix.time,
  buffer,
  loop,
  lcol,
  lty,
  lwd,
  speed,
  width,
  height,
  res,
  fps,
  parallel,
  ...
)

ds_paged(
  t.display,
  title,
  highlight.col,
  highlight.alpha,
  lcol,
  plot.legend,
  spec.width,
  spec.height,
  fps,
  parallel,
  ...
)

ds_static(rows, width, height, res, lcol, alt, fps, play.line)

Arguments

t.display

Time (in s) shown at once: the time window of scrolling spectrograms (default 1.5) or the duration of each page of paged spectrograms (default: the whole sound, up to 5 s).

fix.time

Logical: does the time axis stay fixed (TRUE, default) or move along with the scrolling spectrogram?

buffer

Time (in s) before the scrolling spectrogram starts moving. Default is 0.

loop

Number of times the sound is repeated in scrolling videos (web pages loop until paused when > 1). Default is 1.

lcol

Color of the play line (or cursor of paged spectrograms). Defaults are "#07889B99" (scrolling), "white" (paged) and viridis::mako(10)[9] (static).

lty, lwd

Type and width of the play line of scrolling spectrograms (defaults 2 and 2).

speed

Initial playback speed of scrolling spectrograms (videos are played at this speed). Default is 1.

width, height, res

Size (in pixels) and resolution of the figures: frames of scrolling spectrograms (defaults 700, 400 and 70), and each row of static spectrograms (defaults 1000, 500 and 100).

fps

Frames per second of videos. Defaults are 50 (scrolling) and 30 (paged and static).

parallel

Number of cores used to render videos of scrolling and paged spectrograms. Default is 1.

...

Other arguments of the style:

  • ds_scrolling(): 'hop.size' (window length in ms, used when 'wl' is not set in ds_spectrogram(); default 11.6), 'height.prop' (relative heights of the scrolling spectrogram and the lower panel; default c(5, 1)), 'ggspectro' (use seewave::ggspectro(); default FALSE), 'derivative' (spectral derivatives; requires 'imager'; default FALSE) and 'spectro.call' (a call to a spectrogram function replacing the default one, made with base::call()).

  • ds_paged(): 'resample.rate' (sampling rate in Hz used for the spectrogram; default 15000), 'amp.thresh' (amplitude threshold, as a percentage; default 0), 'filter' (frequency range in kHz to filter out), 'dest.path' (folder for temporary files) and 'delete.temp' (delete temporary files; default TRUE).

title

Title of paged spectrograms.

highlight.col, highlight.alpha

Color and opacity of the highlight box of paged spectrograms (defaults "#4B0C6BFF" and 0.6).

plot.legend

Logical: show the amplitude color scale of paged spectrograms? Default is FALSE.

spec.width, spec.height

Size (in inches) of the pages of paged spectrograms (defaults 9 and 3).

rows

Number of rows in which static spectrograms are split (each row shows a consecutive segment of the same duration). Default is 1.

alt

Alternative text of static spectrograms in web pages (for screen readers).

play.line

Logical: show the line moving along the sound in static spectrograms? With FALSE web pages show the figure without the moving line (clicking on it still plays the sound from that point) and videos show the figure with the sound. Default is TRUE.

Value

A layer to be added to a dynaspec() object with +.

Details

Only the arguments supplied are used; other settings take the defaults shown.

See also

dynaspec(), save_dynaspec()

Examples

data(scythebill)

x <- dynaspec(scythebill, flim = c(1.5, 5.5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl = 200, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1))

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data(antshrike)
y <- dynaspec(antshrike, flim = c(0.5, 5.5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl = 256, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1))
y + ds_scrolling(t.display = 2, axis.type = "minimal")
x + ds_paged(t.display = 1, axis.type = "standard")
x + ds_oscillogram() + ds_static(rows = 2, height = 350)
} # }
